C1_gate0_mechanism.requirement: B arm /v1/metrics contains deferred_session_close with enqueued_total > 0; A arm publishes no deferred_session_close key before or after; both arms operation_settle.retry_total == 0
C1_gate0_mechanism.source: R72 task C1; R71d Gate 0 account semantics
C1_gate0_mechanism.pass_condition: all three clauses hold on the short Gate 0 legs; a missing operation_settle account is FAIL

C2_p1_primary.request: one Hrana JSON pipeline request {"requests":[{"type":"execute","stmt":{"sql":"SELECT 1","want_rows":true}},{"type":"close"}]} over one keep-alive connection per stack
C2_p1_primary.block: exactly 20 consecutive requests; block sample = wall clock of the 20 requests / 20 (ms per request)
C2_p1_primary.triple: A1 (stack A), A2 (stack A), B (stack B) in a random permutation drawn sequentially from random.Random(20261105)
C2_p1_primary.warmup: one discarded pipeline request per stack before the driver starts
C2_p1_primary.pacing: 0.75 s between consecutive blocks, 1.2 s after seeding before the first block
C2_p1_primary.validity: a block with any transport error, non-200 response, or rejected pipeline result fails; a triple with any failed block is VOID, recorded, excluded from statistics, and retried after an extra pause (3 s, doubling on each consecutive void up to 60 s); failures are reported, never hidden
C2_p1_primary.metric: a_i = mean(A1_i, A2_i); effect_i = B_i / a_i; merged ratio = median(effect_i over the 30 valid triples)
C2_p1_primary.bootstrap: 10,000 percentile draws, seed 20261105, resampling the 30 per-triple effects with replacement
C2_p1_primary.pass_condition: (a) merged ratio <= 0.90; (b) bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 1.0; (c) at least 20 of 30 valid triples have effect_i < 1.0 (B faster)
C2_p1_primary.also_reported_not_gating: paired absolute difference d_i = B_i - a_i (ms) median and its bootstrap 95% CI; A2/A1 zero ratio as context only (not a gate in R72)
C2_p1_primary.source: R71d criteria.txt P1 (same wording and seed)

C3_f1_c1.legs: 2 rounds x A/B/B/A with per-round order alternation (round 1 A/B/B/A, round 2 B/A/A/B) = 8 legs per scenario; fresh volume per leg
C3_f1_c1.comparison: pooled p50 and p95 per side per scenario (median of the four per-leg p50/p95 values); per-round ratios reported as context
C3_f1_c1.pass_condition: merged p50 B/A < 1.10 AND merged p95 B/A < 1.10

C4_l1_c1.workload: L1.list-20 json-pipeline, same shape as C3
C4_l1_c1.pass_condition: merged p50 B/A < 1.10 AND merged p95 B/A < 1.10; response byte count identical on both sides (row content identical; query_duration_ms digit width is not a difference)

C5_standard_x1_c8.workload: scripts/perf-reliability/issue28/run.py --scenario X1 --concurrency-requests 100 (levels 1/4/8/16, 100 requests per level; c1/c4 warm up c8)
C5_standard_x1_c8.legs: 2 rounds x A/B/B/A with per-round order alternation = 8 legs; fresh volume per leg
C5_standard_x1_c8.metric: c8 throughput = 100 / harness c8 elapsed seconds; p50/p95 reported
C5_standard_x1_c8.comparison: median c8 throughput per side; merged B/A
C5_standard_x1_c8.pass_condition: merged B/A throughput > 0.90; c8 level must have 0 HTTP 429. The c16 default-quota 429 level is a diagnostic only and never excuses a c8 problem; run.py exit code 1 from the c16 verdict is recorded, not by itself a P2/P3 failure

C6_sustained_c8.workload: 8 concurrent clients, one keep-alive Hrana connection each; one request = the same Hrana JSON pipeline as C2 (implicit open -> execute SELECT 1 -> close); calibration one request per client then 1.5 s admission refill; warm-up 4 blocks = 100 requests per client (discarded); timed 16 blocks = 400 requests per client = 3200 timed requests per leg; one block = 8 clients x 25 requests, 1.2 s between blocks
C6_sustained_c8.metric: throughput = 3200 / (sum of the 16 timed block wall seconds); p50/p95 over the 3200 timed request durations are diagnostics only
C6_sustained_c8.pass_condition: merged B/A throughput > 0.90 AND every leg is free of request failures (calibration, warm-up, timed, and worker errors all zero); a leg with any failed request is invalid and the gate cannot pass while any leg is invalid

requirement: zero 502 / outcome_unknown (and zero 503 / session_moved / audit_unavailable); no unexpected 429 (only the standard X1 c16 diagnostic level may show rate-limit 429)
audit chain continuous with no gaps; audit entry count matches the request count on each side (P1 A:B ratio 2:1 expected by design; P2 same-scenario/round legs match within the two-record tolerance)
the same request sequence on both arms yields identical response bytes / row counts (L1 response byte mode identical, e.g. 15,627 in R71d)
after settling: session_seats=0, active_permits=0, unknown_held_permits=0, native worker sessions=0, worker pending_close=0, cleanup ledger pending_close=0
C7_invariants.source: R72 task C7 + R71d criteria.txt P3

C8_p3.definition: R71d P3 per-leg checks, evaluated over all 34 legs of this round: 2 P1 legs (a, b) + 8 F1 + 8 L1 + 8 standard X1 + 8 sustained c8
C8_p3.pass_condition: 34/34 legs pass every P3 check; a leg with any failed check is invalid and the gate fails while any leg is invalid
C8_p3.source: R71d criteria.txt P3 and collect_invariants.py; R71d achieved 34/34

environment_anomalies.rule: Any outcome_unknown, audit-unavailable, startup failure or other environment anomaly invalidates that leg; it is recorded in place with its evidence, the leg is re-run on a fresh volume after the anomaly is understood, and the invalid attempt stays in the evidence. A slower baseline window is never substituted for a failed leg.

decision_rule: PASS requires every C1-C8 gate to pass and C9 to be either rerun PASS or a documented same-code-path citation. Any failure means the candidate is not merged this round.
